description.text: Introduction: This project is undertaken by School of Energy and Power Engineering of WUT. The school has majors of Power Engineering, Marine Machinery Operation Engineering, Mechanical Engineering and Automation, and Thermal Power Engineering, also has System Simulation and Control and Intelligent Transportation System (ITS) Research Center. It has founded four research facilities, the key laboratory on Power Machinery Engineering directed by the Ministry of Transport, the Energy Efficiency Training Center under direction of the Ministry of Transport, China Classification Society (CCS) measurement center of engine emission and China Classification Society (CCS) measurement center of lubricating oil. Research Orientation: Advanced technical personnel having knowledge of principle of mechanics and marine engine system, etc., fitting in with training, issuing certificates of international seamen and STCW78/95, possessing job qualifications for second assistant engineers of ships of A class, and being able to embark on works like controlling and maintaining turbines, editorial supervision of ships and special inspection of work. Bachelors' Degree for Class Formed Only by International Students are required to have as least 12 students in one program.

duration.text: The Mechanical Engineering and Automation at Wuhan University of Technology is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2777 USD/per year ￥ 20000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 3 or above 6. Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record.

requirements.text: Undergraduates need to learn their major in Chinese after one-year Chinese language study. For students who have basic knowlege of Chinese, don't need to attend the one-year Chinese language study but need to have HSK Band 3 Certificate.
